typography.instructions: Brand font 'TT Modernoir' is unavailable. Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for elegant, high-contrast, editorial display headings (echoing the luxury/geometric Art-Deco feel with wide uppercase tracking) and 'Jost' for structural body text (Art-Deco inspired geometric sans). Add these to Google Fonts import.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-light tracking-[0.2em] uppercase

surface_strategies.name: glassmorphism
surface_strategies.usage: Sticky headers and floating elements. Must use bg-[#071E19]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-[#B19963]/20.

surface_strategies.name: borders
surface_strategies.usage: Use fine gold lines border-[#B19963]/30 for dividing sections, framing images, and button borders. No heavy/thick borders.

surface_strategies.name: shadows
surface_strategies.usage: Soft ambient shadows shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]. Avoid harsh drop shadows.

visual_enhancers.patterns: Subtle oriental/geometric background pattern overlays (opacity-5 mix-blend-overlay). Do not use busy patterns.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections should have py-24 to py-32. Elements should breathe.
layouts.grid: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for asymmetric image galleries (col-span-full to col-span-4). No generic cards.

motion.instructions: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (y: 50, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 1s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). Kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal for headings (using overflow-hidden wrappers). Slow editorial marquee for brand text. Use parallax for the hero image.

component_guidelines.buttons: Elegant minimalist. 1px fine gold border. Transparent background default, filled gold on hover with text-inverse. Avoid default pill shapes, favor sharp or very slightly rounded edges.
component_guidelines.navigation: Transparent at top, transitions to glassmorphic dark green on scroll. Links spaced out generously.
component_guidelines.cards: DO NOT use generic white/gray cards. Use dark surfaces (#08231D) with fine gold borders and high-quality edge-to-edge image crops.
component_guidelines.form: LazyForms integration. Dark minimalist inputs with gold bottom-border only (border-b border-[#B19963]/40). No fully enclosed input boxes. Elegant error/success states.

sections_blueprint.name: Header
sections_blueprint.layout: Fixed, z-50, transition from bg-transparent to backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#071E19]/90. Nav links (Home, Über MAZA, Menü, Galerie, Reservierung, Kontakt) + Gold 'Tisch reservieren' button.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
sections_blueprint.layout: Full-height (min-h-screen). Cinematic atmospheric background image. Large kinetic masked text reveal. Parallax scroll effect. Subtle gold accents.

sections_blueprint.name: Über MAZA (Story)
sections_blueprint.layout: Asymmetric layout. Large atmospheric image offset with a generous text block. Large editorial typography.

sections_blueprint.name: Signature Dishes
sections_blueprint.layout: Editorial grid. 3-4 dishes. No cards. High-end food photography with spotlight treatment. Fine gold lines separating items.

sections_blueprint.layout: Numbered manifesto format (01 to 05). Fine gold line-icons (lucide-react). 'Tradition, Kultur, Qualität, Gastfreundschaft, Orient'. Vertical timeline or horizontal elegant structure.

sections_blueprint.name: Menu Preview
sections_blueprint.layout: Elegant typographic lists. Dotted gold lines connecting dish to price. Clean readable body font.

sections_blueprint.name: Gallery
sections_blueprint.layout: Asymmetric Bento grid. Mix of landscape and portrait crops. Lightbox integration.

sections_blueprint.name: Reservation
sections_blueprint.layout: Premium section. Centered form or two-col layout. Minimalist inputs. Validated states. Gold primary CTA.

sections_blueprint.name: Location & Contact
sections_blueprint.layout: Two column. Contact details and elegant dark-themed placeholder map block.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
sections_blueprint.layout: Dark green background. Generous padding. Large typographic brand logo. Fine gold dividers.

accessibility.contrast_requirements: All text must have a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the dark green background.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-home', data-testid='reservation-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex asymmetric layouts, avoid standard Shadcn cards which look too generic.
Install and configure 'lucide-react' for fine-line icons (set strokeWidth={1} for a high-end look).
Configure Google Fonts for 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Jost' in your index.html or global css.
Implement the LazyForms reservation section using basic customized HTML forms with Tailwind.
Ensure the hero heading uses Framer Motion for a line-by-line staggered masked reveal.
For the philosophy section, strictly use numbered elements (01, 02...) combined with lucide icons and fine gold lines.
No generic buttons. Buttons must be transparent with a 1px gold border, hovering to filled gold. Text must contrast well.
Keep backgrounds predominantly #071E19. Use #F3EFE6 for text.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers where content scrolls underneath. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#071E19]/80.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
